provenance.sampling: Global mean of land surface air temperature (GHCN v4 stations) + sea surface temperature (ERSST v5, ships/buoys)
notes: In-situ based (weather stations, ships and buoys) — NOT a satellite product.
Anomalies relative to the 1951–1980 base period. GISTEMP Team (2026), NASA GISS; Lenssen et al. (2024).
